title: Enforce consistency on config.h include and WS_LOG_DOMAIN
description:
Modify files that have a WS_LOG_DOMAIN set so that:
- config.h is included first, as an application include file,
- the WS_LOG_DOMAIN is set on the very next line.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
